## Why visit

A strong planned meal stop that still advances the beer trip. The first-floor hall pairs Indian street-food dishes with the group’s own beer and guests, and the Liverpool operator page explicitly includes cask lines alongside keg. The communal setting is a change of pace from small snugs, and sharing several dishes works particularly well for two people. It is especially useful for vegetarian eating, with the menu itself worth visiting for rather than treating food as a hurried interruption between pubs.

## Beer

Official location page advertises ten keg and two cask lines, with Bundobust Brewery beer, collaborations and guests.

## Food

Entire food menu is vegetarian with vegan options according to the official FAQ; Indian dishes intended for sharing. Check the current menu and allergens.

## Plan the visit

Book if making it the main meal. First-floor venue has a lift according to the operator; kitchen closes before the bar.

**Getting there:** Bold Street near Liverpool Central; convenient for Ropewalks and Renshaw Street.

Check [November transport issues](../logistics.md) for date-specific disruption.
